observation_summary: The ReturnsSmartNulls feature fails to include method arguments in the error message when an unstubbed method is called, resulting in an empty argument list in the output string.
reasoning_summary: The failure indicates that the logic responsible for formatting the error message (which includes the method name and its arguments) is failing to correctly retrieve or iterate over the arguments provided to the invocation. This is a procedural logic error in how the method arguments are processed for the string representation, which falls under Algorithm/Method.
evidence_used: junit.framework.ComparisonFailure: expected:<... unstubbed withArgs([oompa, lumpa]) method on mock> but was:<... unstubbed withArgs([]) method on mock>
evidence_gaps: The actual production code implementation of ReturnsSmartNulls is not provided, requiring inference of the root cause from the test failure symptom.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the issue involves an invocation object, the failure is in the internal logic of the SmartNull handler formatting its own output, not a mismatch in the interface contract between two components.
